items.name: Leaves
items.description: A handful of fresh green leaves.

items.name: Fern frond
items.description: A curly young frond. Lovely fried.

items.name: Moss
items.description: Soft and springy. Surprisingly good on toast.

items.name: Kawakawa leaf
items.description: Heart-shaped and peppery. The holey ones are the best.

items.name: Berries
items.description: Small, bright and juicy.

items.name: Feijoa
items.description: Fragrant and sweet. Everyone has too many in autumn.

items.name: Pōhutukawa petals
items.description: Crimson petals from the summer tree.

items.name: Nectar
items.description: A sticky drop of sweetness.

items.name: Honeydew
items.description: Sweet sap from the beech trees.

items.name: Worm
items.description: A wriggly classic.

items.name: Giant worm
items.description: Long enough to share. Snails go wild for these.

items.name: Moth
items.description: Dusty wings, crunchy body.

items.name: Cricket
items.description: Chirps until the very end.

items.name: Beetle
items.description: Shiny shell, nutty taste.

items.name: Glowworm
items.description: Glows softly. Only found at night.

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Earthy and plump.

items.name: Truffle
items.description: Kunekune pigs can sniff these out.

items.name: Mud
items.description: Good, rich mud. Ask a pig.

items.name: Bark
items.description: A strip of tough bark. Useful for repairs.

items.name: Spider silk
items.description: Strong, fine thread.

items.name: Shiny button
items.description: Someone lost this. A weka would love it.

items.name: Sea glass
items.description: Smooth and green. Far from the sea.

items.name: Pāua shell
items.description: Swirls of blue and green.

items.name: Kauri gum
items.description: A golden lump of ancient resin. Very rare.

items.name: Recipe scrap (top)
items.description: The top of an old recipe card. It smells of kawakawa.

items.name: Recipe scrap (left)
items.description: A torn corner with a list of ingredients.

items.name: Recipe scrap (right)
items.description: Half a method, in very small handwriting.

items.name: Recipe scrap (bottom)
items.description: The bottom of the card, signed 'R'.

items.name: Kiwi's late-night note
items.description: You met Kiwi snuffling by the stream in the dark. Kiwi scratched out how to make glowworm jelly.

items.name: A muddy recipe scribble
items.description: The kunekune pig rooted up an old tin with a recipe inside, and insisted you keep it.

items.name: Cafe chair
items.description: A little wooden chair. One guest can perch here.

items.name: Cafe table
items.description: A round table for two.

items.name: Log bench
items.description: A split log on stumps. Room for two.

items.name: Potted fern
items.description: A happy fern in a clay pot.

items.name: Flower barrel
items.description: An old barrel spilling with flowers.

items.name: Lantern post
items.description: A warm glow for the evenings.

items.name: Weka's pinched menu card
items.description: Weka 'found' a shiny old menu card on your trip together. It has the beetlejuice recipe on the back, and Weka wants it back.

items.name: Tūī's golden song
items.description: A tūī in the flowering pōhutukawa sang you a song, and somehow the song was a recipe.

recipes.name: Kawakawa scroll
recipes.description: Ruru's famous recipe, pieced back together.

recipes.name: Mud puddle brownies
recipes.description: Squelchy in the middle. In a good way.

companions.name: Kea
companions.description: Uses its beak as a hammer. Finds much more bark.

companions.name: Weka
companions.description: Always steals stuff. Good chance of bringing back something shiny.

companions.name: Pekapeka
companions.description: Sees in the dark and eats insects. Finds more bugs, and spots night visitors.

companions.name: Kunekune pig
companions.description: Slow and friendly, with a nose for mud and fungi. Sniffs out truffles.

perks.name: Big basket
perks.description: Room for one more find each trip.

perks.name: Early bird
perks.description: Up before the worms are. More worms, and more of them.

perks.name: Bark know-how
perks.description: Learned from Kea. A little extra bark every time.

perks.name: Shiny sense
perks.description: Learned from Weka. A small chance of a bonus shiny.

perks.name: Truffle nose
perks.description: Kunekune taught you to sniff out fungi. A little.

perks.name: Silk sense
perks.description: Spider showed you where the silk hangs.

npcs.name: Ruru
npcs.description: The old cafe owner. Wise, sleepy by day, and missing her famous recipe.

npcs.name: Weka
npcs.description: Cheeky, always hanging around the cafe, and steals anything shiny.

npcs.name: Snail
npcs.description: Slurps up giant worms and will spend all day in the cafe if worm pie is on the menu.

npcs.name: Wētā
npcs.description: Nocturnal, lives in a hollow tree trunk that badly needs fixing.

npcs.name: Kea
npcs.description: Clever, nosy and always up for a dare. Knows every bit of bark in the bush.

npcs.name: Pekapeka
npcs.description: Shy, hungry, and very good at finding bugs.

npcs.name: Kererū
npcs.description: A well-fed travelling cook who trades recipes for coins.

quests.title: Hello, Ruru
quests.summary: Ruru, who used to run the cafe, wants to meet you. She'll teach you your first recipe.

dialogue.offer: Oh! A new face in my old cafe. Come and say hello properly.
dialogue.active: Come here, let me have a look at you.
dialogue.ready: Every cafe needs a first dish. Here: my leaf salad. Three handfuls of leaves, that's all it takes.
dialogue.done: A recipe's no good without leaves, mind.

quests.title: Leaves for the salad
quests.summary: A leaf salad needs 3 leaves. Go foraging in the bush (the path at the side of the cafe) until you have them.

dialogue.offer: Your larder's empty! Take the path at the side of the cafe into the bush and forage. Look out for greens, and bring back three handfuls of leaves.
dialogue.active: Three handfuls of leaves. Try looking out for greens when you forage.
dialogue.ready: That's plenty of leaves. Keep them, they're for your salad.
dialogue.done: Off you go. The menu board's by the door.

quests.title: A cafe of my own
quests.summary: Put leaf salad on the menu board by the cafe door, then close for the day. The cafe cooks and sells what's on the menu at closing time.

dialogue.offer: Now let's see you serve it. Put leaf salad on the menu board by the door. When you close up for the day, the cafe cooks and sells what's on the menu. Close in the evening, after your foraging, and more guests come.
dialogue.active: Leaf salad on the menu board, then close up for the day. Evening's best.
dialogue.ready: Ah, I heard the guests liked your salad. You'll do.

quests.title: Somewhere to sit
quests.summary: Ruru has some old furniture in the shed for you.

dialogue.offer: A cafe with nowhere to sit isn't much of a cafe. I've some old bits in the shed. Want them?
dialogue.active: The shed's round the back. Well, I'll fetch them.
dialogue.ready: Here: two chairs, a table, and a fern to make it homely. They're in your bag.
dialogue.done: Set them out and see who drops by.

quests.title: Open for guests
quests.summary: Press Build and set out the chairs, table and fern. Guests sit on chairs you've placed, and a cosier cafe brings them more often.

dialogue.offer: Press Build and set them out however you like. Guests need a chair to sit on, and the cosier it looks, the more often they'll come.
dialogue.active: Set out the chairs, the table and the fern. Press Build.
dialogue.ready: Now that looks like a cafe. Folk will start dropping by, you'll see.
dialogue.done: More things, and nicer things, make it cosier. Cosy brings guests.

quests.title: After dark
quests.summary: Ruru says the bush wakes up at night. Serve a few more dishes and she'll show you.

dialogue.offer: You're getting the hang of this. Keep the guests fed a few more days, and then stay up after closing sometime. Night's when the bush really wakes up.
dialogue.active: Serve a few more dishes. Then stay up late with me.
dialogue.ready: Well done. Tonight, don't rush off to bed. Come and see who's about.
dialogue.done: Night's my favourite. Wētā's up, the bats are out, and you never know who's by the stream.

quests.title: The lost recipe
quests.summary: Ruru's famous kawakawa scroll recipe was torn into four scraps and scattered. Find all four and bring them to her.

dialogue.offer: My kawakawa scroll recipe... the wind took it, and it tore into four. One blew into the bush. I'd bet that weka has another.
dialogue.active: Any luck with the scraps? Try the bush, and ask around the neighbours.
dialogue.ready: All four! Let me piece them together...
dialogue.done: The kawakawa scroll is yours now. Make the village proud.

quests.title: A fair trade
quests.summary: Weka has a recipe scrap and will swap it for a shiny button.

dialogue.offer: Paper? Oh, THIS paper. It's not stolen, it's... found. One shiny button and it's yours.
dialogue.ready: Ooh, shiny! Deal. Take your paper.
dialogue.done: Got anything else shiny? No? Hmph.

quests.title: A very hungry snail
quests.summary: Snail will share something it found if you cook two worm pies.

dialogue.offer: Worm... pie...? Two, please. I found some old paper you can have.
dialogue.ready: Mmmmm. Here. The paper. Slowly. And my friend the kunekune pig wants to forage with you.

quests.title: Hollow home
quests.summary: Wētā's hollow tree trunk is falling apart. Bring 4 bark and 2 silk to patch it up.

dialogue.offer: *rubs hind legs* My trunk is full of holes. Four bark and two silk would fix it. I'll give you a scrap I found inside.
dialogue.active: Four bark, two silk. Kea is good at finding bark.
dialogue.ready: Snug again! Here, take this scrap. And my friend Spider wants to go foraging with you.
dialogue.done: Come by at night. I'm awake then.

quests.title: Kea's dare
quests.summary: Kea dares you to find five bits of bark. Do it, and Kea will come foraging with you.

dialogue.offer: Bet you can't find five bits of bark. Go on. I dare you.
dialogue.active: Five bits of bark. Still waiting!
dialogue.ready: Ha! Not bad for a gecko.
dialogue.done: Fine, I'll come foraging with you. For a few coins. I'm a professional.

quests.title: Show me your moves
quests.summary: Weka wants to see you forage six times before trusting you as a partner.

dialogue.offer: You forage? Prove it. Go out six times, and then we'll talk.
dialogue.active: Six trips. Out in the bush. I'll be counting. Probably.
dialogue.ready: Not bad. Not bad at all.
dialogue.done: Take me along any time. I'll find the shiny things.

quests.title: A bat's breakfast
quests.summary: Pekapeka is too shy to order. Serve six dishes of anything and they'll warm to you.

dialogue.offer: Um. Hello. I'm... just looking. Do you, um, serve food here?
dialogue.active: I'll just... wait here. Until there's lots of food.
dialogue.done: If you ever go out looking for bugs... I could come?

upgrades.name: A second menu slot
upgrades.description: Put two dishes on the menu.

upgrades.name: A busier cafe
upgrades.description: One more dish sold a day.

upgrades.name: An early start
upgrades.description: One more forage trip a day.

upgrades.name: A perk pouch
upgrades.description: Take two perks foraging at once. They stack.

upgrades.name: A third menu slot
upgrades.description: Put three dishes on the menu.

upgrades.name: The talk of the bush
upgrades.description: Yet another dish sold a day.
